title: Dataverse DataFile
description: A data file within a dataset as represented by the University of Chile Dataverse API. Properties reflect the DataFile schema published in the deployment's live OpenAPI document (Dataverse 5.13).

id.description: Internal numeric identifier of the file.

contentType.description: MIME content type of the file.

filesize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

deleted.description: Whether the file is marked deleted.

markedAsDuplicate.description: Whether the file is flagged as a duplicate.

duplicateFilename.description: Filename of the duplicate, if any.

rootDataFileId.description: Root data file id for replaced files.

previousDataFileId.description: Previous data file id for replaced files.

identifier.description: Persistent identifier suffix for the file, if minted.

identifierRegistered.description: Whether the file global ID is registered.

previewImageAvailable.description: Whether a preview image is available.

createDate.description: Creation date of the file record.

dataTables.description: Tabular data tables ingested from the file.
